4) Commercial docs (SOW / PO) & payment terms — owner: Redwood / Novaprospect legal — target: 2026-01-29
5) Vendor activation & test run (limited traffic) — owner: Redwood ops — target: 2026-02-05

Dependencies and blockers noted in the sheet: Ariba account verification often needs bank-account proof; if your procurement team needs us to fill vendor-profile fields, we can assign a specialist to coordinate.

Action items for this week:
